tier_reason: Tier C stands; the headline is narrowed on independent data the enricher reached (Aras Pranckevicius, December 2020, chart-bc7.html in aras-p/aras-p.hugo; Core i9-8950HK, clang 11.0.3, 20 Unity textures, luma PSNR): bc7enc at level 64.4 runs at 0.34x the speed of ispc_texcomp fast (geometric mean; faster on 2 of 20 textures) and at level 16.0 at 0.99x of ispc_texcomp vfast at -0.35 dB; it wins only against ispc_texcomp slow and at lower quality (level 64.4 2.62x faster at -0.79 dB; 64.0 10.6x at -1.45 dB), leading on opaque photo crops and losing up to 4-5 dB on normal maps and alpha textures. The repo's test.cpp is single-threaded with no OpenMP, so the README's multithreaded harness is absent, and the BC1 claim against libsquish and Compressonator is measured nowhere (Aras: rgbcx level 0 is 1.07x stb_dxt at -0.17 dB and ispc_texcomp is 2.1x faster than rgbcx 0).

corrections.claimed_speedup: README (first-party, bc7enc16 era, 31 images, multithreaded, luma PSNR): ispc_texcomp slow 355.4 s at 48.6 dB vs bc7enc16 uber0/max_partitions 64 38.3 s at 49.6 dB (9.3x, derived from page data). Independent (Aras Pranckevicius, Dec 2020, i9-8950HK, clang 11.0.3, 20 Unity textures, luma PSNR, derived from chart data): bc7enc level 64.4 at 0.34x the speed of ispc_texcomp fast (faster on 2 of 20), level 16.0 at 0.99x of ispc_texcomp vfast at -0.35 dB; wins only against ispc_texcomp slow at lower quality (2.62x at -0.79 dB, 10.6x at -1.45 dB). BC1: README claims rgbcx is 3-4x faster than libsquish cluster fit with no timings; Aras measured rgbcx level 0 at 1.07x stb_dxt (-0.17 dB) and ispc_texcomp BC1 2.1x faster than rgbcx 0.
